subject: Pilot intake: dedicated capacity demo & capacity profile review
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@atlasedge.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood self-signup - pilot interest (dedicated capacity)

Hi Connor / Ben,

Thanks for the quick on-ramp — we signed up via the self-serve flow and would like to move to a short technical demo to validate Dedicated capacity for a pilot. High-level requirements:
- Average request payload: ~220 tokens (user prompt + system tokens).
- Peak sustained throughput we expect: ~180 requests/min (with bursts to 480 r/min for short windows).
- P95 latency target: <= 250ms for generation up to 512 tokens.
- We will need to evaluate KV cache behavior and warmup for steady-state throughput.

Primary goals for the call: confirm capacity sizing, run a quick test with our sample dataset, and agree on a mutual action plan for the pilot.

Can you do a 60-minute deep-dive this week? Our timezone is US/PDT. I can make Tue afternoon or Wed morning work.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Platform
AtlasEdge
[Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (PDF, 1 page)]
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood self-signup - pilot interest (dedicated capacity)

Laura — really appreciate the details, this is exactly the kind of signal we need. I looped in Marissa (solutions engineer) to cover runtime/benchmarking and Ben (SDR) to coordinate scheduling.

A couple quick clarifying questions before we lock a slot:
- Is the 180 r/min a sustained baseline you expect for the pilot or an expected average after warmup?
- Do you have a representative workload file (sample prompts + expected response lengths)? A 50–100 request CSV is ideal for an initial run.
- Any compliance/region requirements (e.g., data residency, SOC2 evidence) we should flag ahead of the call?

Proposed agenda (60 min):
1) 10 min intros + overview of AtlasEdge use case
2) 20 min deep dive: capacity profile, latency SLOs, failure modes
3) 20 min hands-on: run a short throughput test against a dedicated pool + observe p95/p99
4) 10 min next steps + MAP alignment

If that looks good I will have Marissa bring a prepared capacity template and ask our SRE to be on standby for the test.

Connor
Principal Solutions — Redwood Inference
